description: ICD-11 nodes that are too coarse to accept for an injury extraction. If an injury is classified to one of these nodes the case is flagged and the partial-edit agent re-walks the tree (or the node's parent) forbidding the coarse option, forcing a more specific decision.

categories.multiple: Node describes several body parts/structures at once.
categories.region_catchall: Region-level "Other specified"/"unspecified" node that skips specificity.
categories.broad_region: Node covering a broad anatomical region or several organs.
